commonPrompt: Original cosy dreamy LOFI landscape illustration for the HeatSafe weather card. Wide 3:2 landscape. Hand-painted gouache and soft cel-shaded shapes, pastel palette, subtle fine paper grain, layered atmospheric countryside, tiny Australian cottages and eucalyptus trees, gentle river, peaceful mood. Detailed and tasteful, NOT photorealistic, NOT generic clip art. Keep upper-left 40% simple for UI text overlay, interesting landscape on middle and right, full-bleed art. No text, no logos, no interface, no borders. Every composition must be distinctive.

scenes.sunny: Sunny day: pastel powder-blue sky, diffuse warm sunlight from upper right, lush rounded green hills, three tiny terracotta-roof cottages on a hillside to the right, a winding S-shaped river from bottom left to distant middle, wildflower meadow and eucalyptus at the left edge. No drawn sun disk; leave space in upper right for animated sun.
scenes.partly-cloudy: Partly cloudy afternoon: peach-to-blue sky, huge soft ivory cumulus clouds drifting across upper right, rolling mint and sage countryside, a tiny cream farmhouse and a windmill on the left distant hill, river bending horizontally across middle, a footbridge and lavender flowers in foreground. Warm patches of sunlight and cloud shadows. No sun disk.
scenes.overcast: Overcast: dense layered lavender-grey clouds, misty rolling hills in slate sage, a cluster of tiny blue-roofed houses beside a lake on the right, foreground wooden fence and lush fern garden, distant pine and eucalyptus silhouettes. Quiet diffuse flat lighting with deep atmospheric perspective, no sun or moon.
scenes.rainy: Rainy day: blue-grey rain clouds and scenery, foreground cosy cottage with wet rust-red rooftop on right, warm window, dripping eaves suggested in painting, a narrow winding riverside lane with puddles reflecting the house, many soft concentric ripples on river in middle, distant hills fading in rain haze. No sun or moon, no dramatic streaks; animated rain added separately.
scenes.thunderstorm: Thunderstorm: deep purple layered storm clouds filling half the sky, distant indigo mountains across a swollen winding river, a tiny ochre cottage sheltered among dark eucalyptus trees on the right slope, foreground windswept grasses and dark wet rocks. Rich violet shadows and a single steady amber window. Atmospheric distant storm, NO lightning bolts, NO flashes, no sun or moon; rain added separately.
scenes.foggy: Foggy morning: pale muted cream, sage and lavender-grey scenery, many layers of eucalyptus tree silhouettes dissolving into low fog, a tiny wooden cottage barely visible near right middle, a curving country footpath through dew-wet grasses leading to a narrow still stream, foreground delicate reeds, tranquil and soft. No visible sun or moon.
scenes.clear-night: Clear night: deep indigo sky, small delicate stars and moonlit lavender hills, warmly lit tiny cottages grouped along a river bend on right, golden windows reflecting on dark still water, foreground eucalyptus branches and a little garden gate, beautiful cosy blue and amber contrast. NO moon disk; reserve upper right sky for animated moon.
scenes.cloudy-night: Cloudy night: a distinct deep navy and mauve landscape, large layered silver-edged clouds partially covering the upper-right moonlight (no visible moon disk), an isolated teal-roof farmhouse on a terraced hill, warm porch lamps, dark cypress and eucalyptus trees, small river in the valley at lower left, cool cloud-shadowed rolling fields. No rain, no stars visible.
scenes.rainy-night: Rainy night: deep midnight-blue village beside a canal, warmly glowing amber windows on two small red-roof cottages to the right, wet cobblestone footpath in foreground reflecting tiny lanterns, dark cloudy sky, low arched bridge in distance, circles of rain ripples on the canal. Cosy quiet shelter in rain, no moon or stars, rain streaks added separately.
scenes.hot: Hot daytime: pastel peach-orange sky with soft dusty haze, golden dry rolling hills, a pale terracotta-roof building under broad shady eucalyptus trees on right, narrow slow river flowing across lower foreground, sun-dried grasses, shaded veranda and distant ochre hills, warm honey highlights. No flames, no distress, no sun disk; gentle heat shimmer added separately.
scenes.hot-night: Warm summer night: muted plum and dusty rose night sky, golden dry hills dimly lit, tiny sandstone cottages with shaded verandas and steady amber windows to the right, calm narrow creek reflecting copper moonlight, foreground dry meadow and dark eucalyptus, atmospheric warm haze. Clearly night, no sun, no visible moon disk, no flames.
scenes.snow: Snowy day: soft powder blue and lavender-white sky, gentle snow-covered foothills, a tiny red-roof alpine cottage with warm windows on right, snowy eucalyptus and evergreen trees, a winding partly frozen stream in foreground with little wooden footbridge, cosy cool muted gouache palette. No sun or moon. Fine snowfall will be animated above.
